title: JulekPL10's Plant Craft
description: Plant Craft is an innovative mod expanding the world of Minecraft with unique biomes and flora.
body:
Plant Craft is an innovative mod expanding the world of Minecraft with unique biomes and flora. Explore Burnt Forest, a haunting charred wasteland. Updates also enhance Taiga, Desert, Savanna, and Meadow biomes with new plants and features. To fully enjoy this mod, download the Core Craft mod here, as it’s required for Plant Craft to work. Experience a greener, richer Minecraft world!

50+ new blocks
4+ new mobs
30+ new items
4+ new biomes

and more.
